name: treasury-fiscaldata-mcp-server
description: Query US Treasury national debt, interest rates, exchange rates, and fiscal datasets via MCP.

dataframe_drop_enabled.title: Enable Dataframe Drop
dataframe_drop_enabled.description: Enable treasury_dataframe_drop to delete staged dataframes. Requires the duckdb canvas provider.

canvas_provider_type.title: Canvas Provider Type
canvas_provider_type.description: Canvas engine for DataCanvas SQL tools. 'duckdb' enables treasury_dataframe_* tools; 'none' disables them.
